transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Well, I guess what finally made me agree to come in is that I just don't care about the things that used to keep me balanced. I used to love sailing races, my Saturday historical society shift, even just tinkering in the woodshop... but now, they all just feel like chores that I keep putting off.
Have you ever had a similar period of losing interest in things before?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I was busy with work or tired and skipped a weekend of sailing, but... no, nothing like this where I just completely lost the desire to do any of it. This is new for me.
Did this loss of interest begin after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?
Yeah, it did. This has all been going on since the scaffold accident... that happened during a business readjustment we were doing. It's been, I'd say, a little over a year now since that happened.
Did you sustain a diagnosed brain injury or other significant medical injury in the scaffold accident?
No, I didn't. I mean, I got banged up a bit—just some bruises and soreness—but no, no brain injury or broken bones or anything significant like that. Physically, I walked away mostly fine.
Are the effects or consequences of the scaffold accident still affecting your life now?

Yeah, it is. I mean, I’m still doing my job, but... I’ve started delegating site visits that I really should be leading myself. And I find myself avoiding client discussions if they touch on the accident at all. It just makes me worry that I’m not giving the project the steady direction it really needs right now.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day on most days?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... I don't really feel sad or down most of the time. It's more just the stress and the worry about the site visits, like I mentioned. But I'm not sitting around feeling depressed or anything like that.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I still have plans and things I want to accomplish. I'm not giving up on my career or anything, I just... I just have this issue with the site visits right now. But overall, no, I wouldn't say I feel hopeless about what's ahead.
